build_refinement_core: build a recurrent refinement module combining an encoder net, recurrent net, and refinement head for iterative latent variable updates
build_res_head: build a residual refinement head that updates latent variables by adding a linear transformation of inputs to the previous latent state
build_predictor_corrector_head: build a gated predictor-corrector head for sequential data that combines prediction from previous timesteps with correction from the current refinement network
review_refinement_core_prepare_spatial_i: review the RefinementCore prepare_spatial_inputs method that tiles single-scale inputs and concatenates multi-scale spatial tensors along the channel axis
review_refinement_core_prepare_flat_inpu: review the RefinementCore prepare_flat_inputs method that flattens and concatenates latent-space inputs with encoded hidden representations
